definitions.explanation: A small mirror with a handle, designed to be held in the hand. Used for checking one's appearance while on the go.

examples.japanese: {手鏡|てかがみ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I checked my face in a hand mirror.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ (hand) + ⟦{鏡|かがみ}→鏡：02190_kagami⟧ (mirror). A small mirror with a handle, designed to be held in one hand.

At hair salons, the stylist uses a {手鏡|てかがみ} to show the customer the back of their head after cutting. Also a common personal grooming item carried in bags.
